raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview 1) Muse has a pattern rmsnorm + add + rmsnorm. This PR adds a fused kernel for these operations. Previously it had a single kernel that was from inductor but the custom AITER fused kernel has better perf (~2us / 40%) in decode and 30-40us / 50% in prefill. 2) Fuse the rmsnorm + reshape + rope and cache kernel. 3) (2) required AITER FA to be default. Baseline is using using vllm's ROCm FA backend which is not optimized. ## Claims TPOT and total tok/s should speed up substantially. ## Validation Concurrency | A TTFT ms | B TTFT ms | A TPOT ms | B TPOT ms | A total tok/s | B total tok/s -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- 1 | 60.4 | 57.2 | 13.5 | 11.0 | 147.5 | 181.9 2 | 88.2 | 98.4 | 14.0 | 11.3 | 283.6 | 350.5 4 | 162.1 | 162.1 | 15.0 | 11.5 | 526.9 | 688.7 8 | 290.0 | 294.3 | 16.4 | 12.6 | 958.2 | 1243.9 16 | 532.3 | 487.2 | 16.8 | 13.0 | 1846.3 | 2364.3 32 | 849.7 | 788.1 | 18.1 | 14.3 | 3379.8 | 4247.4 64 | 1388.2 | 1237.4 | 20.4 | 16.3 | 5888.8 | 7301.0 128 | 2125.1 | 1975.2 | 24.9 | 20.5 | 9462.5 | 11361.2 There should be a ~20% improvement in TPOT and total throughput (latter for decode heavy cases) and a ~5% improvement in TTFT. ## Details Fusions improve performance in decode by amortizing kernel launch latency. Moving to fused kernels improves decode performance and in some cases also TTFT. Before: The three kernels pre-attention are ~4us each (this is (1) from the Overview). The rmsnorm is 6us and is also ~30% larger in prefill (not in screenshot) most likely due to inductor not being great at generalizing for shapes (this is (2) from Overview). Attention is 144us (this is (3) from Overview). After: The fused kernel ((1)) is 4us (vs 12), rmsnorm is 4us (vs 6) and also ~30% faster and attention is 27us vs 144. There should be no changes to any backend other than ROCm. The changes are gated to both rocm and AITER being enabled. There is a new fusion pass added for the rmsnorm+add+rmsnorm as that did not exist before. Same with the qk rope pass. Unit tests are added for both. ---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+"""Muse's sandwich norm fusion, including the decoder-layer boundary."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from tests.compile.backend import TestBackend as CompileTestBackend
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.muse_glimmer_sandwich_norm_fusion import (
+    MuseSandwichNormFusionPass,
+)
+from vllm.compilation.passes.pass_manager import PostGradPassManager
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.noop_elimination import NoOpEliminationPass
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.post_cleanup import PostCleanupPass
+from vllm.config import (
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CompilationMode,
+    VllmConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.models.muse_glimmer import MuseGlimmerDecoderLayer
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm() or not rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled(),
+    reason="Requires ROCm with AITER enabled",
+)
+
+
+class _IdentityAttention(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor):
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+def _make_layer(width: int) -> MuseGlimmerDecoderLayer:
+    layer = MuseGlimmerDecoderLayer.__new__(MuseGlimmerDecoderLayer)
+    nn.Module.__init__(layer)
+    layer.self_attn = _IdentityAttention()
+    layer.mlp = nn.Identity()
+    layer.input_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(width, eps=1e-5)
+    layer.post_attention_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(width, eps=1e-8)
+    layer.pre_feedforward_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(width, eps=1e-5)
+    layer.post_feedforward_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(width, eps=1e-8)
+    return layer
+
+
+class _TwoMuseLayers(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, width: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(_make_layer(width) for _ in range(2))
+
+    def forward(self, positions: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor):
+        first, residual = self.layers[0](positions, x, None)
+        return self.layers[1](positions, first, residual)
+
+
+def test_muse_sandwich_norm_pass_follows_aiter_switch(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> None:
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("Muse AITER sandwich norm requires gfx950")
+
+    text_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        hidden_size=6656, post_norm_eps=1e-8, rms_norm_eps=1e-5
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE)
+    )
+    config.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        hf_config=text_config,
+        architecture="MuseGlimmerForCausalLM",
+        using_transformers_backend=lambda: False,
+    )
+    manager = PostGradPassManager()
+    manager.configure(config)
+    assert any(isinstance(p, MuseSandwichNormFusionPass) for p in manager.passes)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_enabled", lambda: False)
+    disabled_manager = PostGradPassManager()
+    disabled_manager.configure(config)
+    assert not any(
+        isinstance(p, MuseSandwichNormFusionPass) for p in disabled_manager.passes
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 64, 257])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_muse_sandwich_norm_fusion_across_layers(rows: int) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(1064)
+    width = 6656
+    text_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        hidden_size=width, post_norm_eps=1e-8, rms_norm_eps=1e-5
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE)
+    )
+    config.model_config = SimpleNamespace(dtype=torch.bfloat16, hf_config=text_config)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        model = _TwoMuseLayers(width).to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        for layer in model.layers:
+            for norm in (
+                layer.input_layernorm,
+                layer.post_attention_layernorm,
+                layer.pre_feedforward_layernorm,
+                layer.post_feedforward_layernorm,
+            ):
+                norm.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=0.1)
+
+        positions = torch.arange(rows, device="cuda")
+        x = torch.randn(rows, width, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        expected = model(positions, x)
+
+        fusion_pass = MuseSandwichNormFusionPass(config)
+        backend = CompileTestBackend(
+            NoOpEliminationPass(config), fusion_pass, PostCleanupPass(config)
+        )
+        actual = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)(positions, x)
+
+    # Each post-attention norm pair matches, and the first layer's post-FFN
+    # norm matches the input norm of the second layer.
+    if fusion_pass.matched_count != 3:
+        backend.print_graphs()
+    assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 3
+    for actual_tensor, expected_tensor in zip(actual, expected, strict=True):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual_tensor, expected_tensor, atol=0.05, rtol=0.05)
+    backend.check_after_ops([torch.ops.aiter.fused_rmsnorm_add_rmsnorm])

+class MuseQKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel(QKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel):
+    q_scale = 3.875
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.qk_norm = RMSNorm(
+            self.head_size, eps=self.q_norm.variance_epsilon, has_weight=False
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, qkv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q = q.reshape(-1, self.head_size)
+        q = self.qk_norm(q).reshape(-1, self.q_size) * self.q_scale
+        k = k.reshape(-1, self.head_size)
+        k = self.qk_norm(k).reshape(-1, self.kv_size)
+        q = q.to(v.dtype)
+        k = k.to(v.dtype)
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+        q = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_size)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size)
+        dummy = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(
+            k, v, _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name)
+        )
+        return q, k, v, dummy
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [5, 512])
+def test_muse_qk_norm_rope_cache_fuses_all_token_counts(
+    num_tokens: int, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_ROPE", "0")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT", "0")
+    rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+    device = torch.device(os.environ.get("VLLM_TEST_CUDA_DEVICE", "cuda"))
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(
+            model=os.environ.get("VLLM_TEST_MODEL", "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        ),
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(block_size=16, cache_dtype="auto"),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            custom_ops=["+rotary_embedding"],
+            use_inductor_graph_partition=True,
+        ),
+    )
+    text_config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    text_config.head_dim = 128
+    text_config.layer_rope_theta = [10000.0]
+    text_config.rms_norm_eps = 1e-6
+    text_config.qk_scale_factor = MuseQKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel.q_scale
+    with vllm.config.set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        model = MuseQKNormRoPEKVCacheTestModel(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            attn_backend=AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA,
+            num_heads=32,
+            num_kv_heads=8,
+            head_size=128,
+            is_neox=True,
+            rms_norm_eps=1e-6,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device=device,
+        ).to(device)
+        fusion_pass = MuseGlimmerQkRopeCacheFusionPass(vllm_config)
+        backend = TestBackend(
+            NoOpEliminationPass(vllm_config),
+            SplitCoalescingPass(vllm_config),
+            ScatterSplitReplacementPass(vllm_config),
+            fusion_pass,
+            PostCleanupPass(vllm_config),
+        )
+        qkv = torch.randn(
+            num_tokens,
+            model.q_size + 2 * model.kv_size,
+            device=device,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        positions = torch.arange(num_tokens, device=device)
+
+        with set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+            context = get_forward_context()
+            metadata = model.build_attn_metadata(num_tokens, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC)
+            context.slot_mapping = {model.layer_name: metadata.slot_mapping}
+            expected = model(qkv, positions)
+            expected_cache = model.attn.kv_cache.clone()
+
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(qkv, 0)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(positions, 0)
+        with set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+            context = get_forward_context()
+            metadata = model.build_attn_metadata(num_tokens, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC)
+            context.slot_mapping = {model.layer_name: metadata.slot_mapping}
+            actual = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)(qkv, positions)
+            actual_cache = model.attn.kv_cache.clone()
+
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 1
+        backend.check_before_ops([torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update.default])
+        backend.check_after_ops([torch.ops.vllm.fused_muse_qk_rope_cache.default])
+        for expected_tensor, actual_tensor in zip(expected[:3], actual[:3]):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                expected_tensor, actual_tensor, atol=4e-2, rtol=2e-2
+            )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(expected_cache, actual_cache, atol=4e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import inspect
+from functools import cache
+
+import torch
+import torch._inductor.pattern_matcher as pm
+from torch import fx
+from torch._inductor.fx_passes.post_grad import view_to_reshape
+from torch._inductor.pattern_matcher import PatternMatcherPass
+
+import vllm.ir.ops
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_layers_from_vllm_config
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import (
+    Attention,
+    get_attention_context,
+)
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import (
+    _USE_LAYERNAME,
+    LayerNameType,
+    _encode_layer_name,
+    _resolve_layer_name,
+    direct_register_custom_op,
+)
+
+from ..inductor_pass import enable_fake_mode
+from ..vllm_inductor_pass import VllmInductorPass, VllmPatternMatcherPass
+from .matcher_utils import MatcherRotaryEmbedding
+from .rms_quant_fusion import empty_bf16, empty_i64
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@cache
+def _zero_weight(device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.zeros(128, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _fused_muse_qk_rope_cache_impl(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: float,
+    eps: float,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    from aiter.ops.triton.rope.fused_qkv_split_qk_norm_rope_cache import (
+        fused_qkv_split_qk_norm_rope_cache,
+    )
+
+    layer_name = _resolve_layer_name(layer_name)
+    _, attn_layer, kv_cache, slot_mapping = get_attention_context(layer_name)
+    if slot_mapping is None:
+        q = qkv.new_zeros((qkv.shape[0], num_heads, head_dim))
+        k = qkv.new_zeros((qkv.shape[0], num_kv_heads, head_dim))
+        v = qkv.new_zeros((qkv.shape[0], num_kv_heads, head_dim))
+    else:
+        key_cache, value_cache = attn_layer.impl._split_kv_cache(kv_cache)
+        cos, sin = cos_sin_cache.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        weight = _zero_weight(qkv.device)
+        q, k, v = fused_qkv_split_qk_norm_rope_cache(
+            qkv,
+            weight,
+            weight,
+            cos,
+            sin,
+            positions,
+            key_cache,
+            value_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            num_heads,
+            num_kv_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            is_neox=True,
+            eps=eps,
+            q_scale=q_scale,
+            kv_cache_layout="NHD",
+        )
+    return q, k, v, qkv.new_empty(0)
+
+
+def _fused_muse_qk_rope_cache_fake(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: float,
+    eps: float,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    return (
+        qkv.new_empty((qkv.shape[0], num_heads, head_dim)),
+        qkv.new_empty((qkv.shape[0], num_kv_heads, head_dim)),
+        qkv.new_empty((qkv.shape[0], num_kv_heads, head_dim)),
+        qkv.new_empty(0),
+    )
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="fused_muse_qk_rope_cache",
+    op_func=_fused_muse_qk_rope_cache_impl,
+    mutates_args=[],
+    fake_impl=_fused_muse_qk_rope_cache_fake,
+)
+
+
+class MuseGlimmerQkRopeCachePattern:
+    def __init__(self, layer: Attention, eps: float, q_scale: float) -> None:
+        self.layer_name = layer.layer_name
+        self.num_heads = layer.num_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = layer.num_kv_heads
+        self.head_dim = layer.head_size
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.q_scale = q_scale
+        self.rope = MatcherRotaryEmbedding(
+            is_neox=True,
+            head_size=self.head_dim,
+            num_heads=self.num_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+        )
+
+    def _norm(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return vllm.ir.ops.rms_norm(x, None, self.eps)
+
+    def pattern(
+        self,
+        qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        layer_name: LayerNameType | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q = self._norm(q.reshape(-1, self.head_dim))
+        q = q.reshape(-1, self.q_size) * self.q_scale
+        k = self._norm(k.reshape(-1, self.head_dim))
+        k = k.reshape(-1, self.kv_size)
+        q = q.to(v.dtype)
+        k = k.to(v.dtype)
+        q, k = self.rope(positions, q, k, cos_sin_cache)
+        q = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        encoded = _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name)
+        dummy = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(
+            k, v, encoded if layer_name is None else layer_name
+        )
+        return dummy, q, k, v
+
+    def replacement(
+        self,
+        qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        layer_name: LayerNameType | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        encoded = _encode_layer_name(self.layer_name)
+        q, k, v, dummy = torch.ops.vllm.fused_muse_qk_rope_cache(
+            qkv,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            self.q_scale,
+            self.eps,
+            encoded if layer_name is None else layer_name,
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.num_kv_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+        )
+        return dummy, q, k, v
+
+    def register(self, patterns: PatternMatcherPass) -> None:
+        inputs = [
+            empty_bf16(5, self.q_size + 2 * self.kv_size),
+            empty_i64(5),
+            empty_bf16(4096, self.head_dim),
+        ]
+        if _USE_LAYERNAME:
+            inputs.append(_encode_layer_name(self.layer_name))
+
+            def pattern(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache, layer_name):
+                return self.pattern(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache, layer_name)
+
+            def replacement(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache, layer_name):
+                return self.replacement(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache, layer_name)
+
+        else:
+
+            def pattern(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache):
+                return self.pattern(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache)
+
+            def replacement(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache):
+                return self.replacement(qkv, positions, cos_sin_cache)
+
+        def trace_fn(fn, args, **kwargs):
+            graph = pm.fwd_only(fn, args, **kwargs)
+            view_to_reshape(graph)
+            return graph
+
+        search_graph = trace_fn(pattern, inputs)
+        search_pattern = pm.fx_to_pattern(
+            search_graph,
+            ignore_types=(int, torch.SymInt),
+            argnames=list(inspect.signature(pattern).parameters),
+        )
+        pm.register_replacement(
+            pattern,
+            replacement,
+            inputs,
+            trace_fn,
+            patterns,
+            search_fn_pattern=search_pattern,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseGlimmerQkRopeCacheFusionPass(VllmPatternMatcherPass):
+    @enable_fake_mode
+    def __init__(self, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.patterns = PatternMatcherPass(pass_name="muse_qk_rope_cache_fusion")
+
+        from vllm.model_executor.models.muse_glimmer import _text_config
+        from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import (
+            AiterFlashAttentionBackend,
+        )
+
+        text_config = _text_config(config.model_config.hf_config)
+        for _, layer in get_layers_from_vllm_config(config, Attention).items():
+            layer_idx = extract_layer_index(layer.layer_name)
+            if (
+                not text_config.layer_rope_theta[layer_idx]
+                or layer.get_attn_backend() is not AiterFlashAttentionBackend
+                or layer.kv_cache_dtype != "auto"
+                or layer.head_size != 128
+                or not layer.impl.fused_qk_norm_rope_kvcache_supported()
+            ):
+                continue
+            MuseGlimmerQkRopeCachePattern(
+                layer,
+                text_config.rms_norm_eps,
+                text_config.qk_scale_factor,
+            ).register(self.patterns)
+            if _USE_LAYERNAME:
+                break
+
+        self.dump_patterns(config, self.patterns)
+
+    @VllmInductorPass.time_and_log
+    def __call__(self, graph: fx.Graph) -> None:
+        self.matched_count = self.patterns.apply(graph)
+        logger.info("Muse QK-norm+RoPE+KV-cache fusion: %d matches", self.matched_count)
+
+    def uuid(self) -> str:
+        return VllmInductorPass.hash_source(self, MuseGlimmerQkRopeCachePattern)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Fuse Muse's Gemma-style RMSNorm, residual add, and second RMSNorm."""
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.ir.ops
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+from ..vllm_inductor_pass import (
+    VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass,
+    VllmPatternReplacement,
+)
+
+
+class MuseSandwichNormPattern(VllmPatternReplacement):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        post_eps: float,
+        pre_eps: float,
+        fused_add: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.post_eps = post_eps
+        self.pre_eps = pre_eps
+        self.fused_add = fused_add
+
+    @property
+    def pattern(self):
+        post_eps = self.post_eps
+        pre_eps = self.pre_eps
+        fused_add = self.fused_add
+
+        def _pattern(x, residual, post_weight, pre_weight):
+            post_norm = vllm.ir.ops.rms_norm(x, post_weight.float() + 1.0, post_eps)
+            if fused_add:
+                return vllm.ir.ops.fused_add_rms_norm(
+                    post_norm, residual, pre_weight.float() + 1.0, pre_eps
+                )
+            residual_out = residual + post_norm
+            pre_norm = vllm.ir.ops.rms_norm(
+                residual_out, pre_weight.float() + 1.0, pre_eps
+            )
+            return pre_norm, residual_out
+
+        return _pattern
+
+    @property
+    def replacement(self):
+        post_eps = self.post_eps
+        pre_eps = self.pre_eps
+
+        def _replacement(x, residual, post_weight, pre_weight):
+            from aiter.ops.triton.normalization.fused_rmsnorm_add_rmsnorm import (
+                fused_rmsnorm_add_rmsnorm,
+            )
+
+            residual_out = torch.empty_like(x)
+            pre_norm = fused_rmsnorm_add_rmsnorm(
+                x,
+                residual,
+                post_weight,
+                pre_weight,
+                post_eps,
+                pre_eps,
+                residual_out,
+            )
+            return pre_norm, residual_out
+
+        return _replacement
+
+    def get_inputs(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        width = self.hidden_size
+        return [
+            self.empty_bf16(5, width),
+            self.empty_bf16(5, width),
+            self.empty_bf16(width),
+            self.empty_bf16(width),
+        ]
+
+
+class MuseSandwichNormFusionPass(VllmFusionPatternMatcherPass):
+    def __init__(self, config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config, "muse_sandwich_norm_fusion_pass")
+
+        from vllm.model_executor.models.muse_glimmer import _text_config
+
+        text_config = _text_config(config.model_config.hf_config)
+        for fused_add in (True, False):
+            self.register(
+                MuseSandwichNormPattern(
+                    text_config.hidden_size,
+                    text_config.post_norm_eps,
+                    text_config.rms_norm_eps,
+                    fused_add,
+                )
+            )
+
+        self.dump_patterns(config, self.pm_pass)
